best_hooks: Short legs don't make you slow. Landing in front of your hips does. (Kipchoge, foot-to-hip distance line)
Long legs don't make Bolt fast. Fewer, harder steps do. (Bolt, step counter + timing bar)
Your lungs don't quit first. Your cadence does. (Kipchoge, metronome timing bar)
one_line_case: Biggest participation and proven app spend (Strava bought Runna), with no animated faceless form account found; the engine fits one side-on body perfectly, but stars pull less and Ochy is the app rival for a form wedge.
